note: Read only by the benchmark controller. Never give any of this to the application under test or to the test-generation engine. The bench extension: added to catalogue.json's defects when a run names --catalogue 2026-11-21.1, and scored apart from them (the extension score).

reachable.BS-09: The base marks it unreachable (row 233: API tests got no token). With Phase 4's API sign-in (T4) the API tests sign in, and Phase 4 CP1 detected it in 5 of 5 trials.

defects.expected: The cart and review pages show the same total as the cart in the API (subtotal minus discount plus shipping).
defects.actual: The cart page shows the total before the discount is taken off; the API total is right.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; one line in the cart; code SAVE10 applied.
reproduction: Add Desk Lamp ($34.50) to the cart
The API total is 3605 cents ($36.05); the cart page shows $39.50
defects.impact: Customers are shown a different amount from the one they are charged.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a displayed value compared with the API's value for the same cart.

defects.expected: When two payments of the same placed order arrive at the same time, one succeeds and the other is refused (409).
defects.actual: Two payments sent at the same time both succeed (200); the state check and the change are not done together.
reproduction: Send POST /api/orders/<id>/pay twice at the same time

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs requests sent in parallel; sequential tests never see it.

defects.expected: A refused discount code leaves the cart as it was: a code applied before stays applied.
defects.actual: A refused code (400) still removes the code applied before; the discount is gone.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; one line in the cart; code SAVE10 applied.
reproduction: The cart has no code and no discount
defects.impact: A typing mistake silently costs the customer their discount.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a read before and after a refused write.

defects.expected: A default address over 200 characters is refused with 400 and a message, and the Account page shows the message.
defects.actual: The API answers 500 to an address over 200 characters, and the Account page still says 'Saved.'.
reproduction: Enter an address of 201 characters and Save
The page says 'Saved.'; PUT /api/profile answered 500; a reload shows the old address
defects.impact: Customers believe a change was saved when it was not.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a maxLength case and a check of the action's API answer behind a success message.

defects.expected: Registering with an existing email address in a different letter case is refused (409).
defects.actual: An existing email address in a different letter case creates a second account.
defects.impact: Two accounts for one person; sign-in picks one of them.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a duplicate-key case with a case-changed value.

defects.expected: Placing an order removes the cart together with its lines; no stored cart line is left without its cart.
defects.actual: Placing an order deletes the cart but leaves its item rows in the stored data.
defects.preconditions: Signed in; one line in the cart; a delivery address given.
reproduction: Give a delivery address and place the order
The stored data has cart_items rows whose cart no longer exists
defects.impact: Stored data grows inconsistent; reports and clean-up jobs miscount.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: The API never shows it; only a read of the stored data does.

defects.expected: GET /api/orders/{id} matches its documented response schema: total is an integer number of cents.
defects.actual: GET /api/orders/{id} returns total as a string.
defects.preconditions: Signed in as alice@example.test, who has order ord-1000.
defects.impact: Clients written from the documentation break or add text instead of numbers.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: The response-schema check exists; it needs the documented response schemas and a signed-in call.

defects.expected: No API response contains a password or other sign-in secret.
reproduction: The answer has a password field with the account's password
defects.impact: Anyone who can read the response (a script, a proxy log) learns the password.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a sensitive-field check over captured responses.

defects.expected: After 5 failed sign-ins for one email address within a minute, sign-in for it is refused for a minute (429).
defects.actual: Failed sign-ins are never limited; the correct password still works after any number of failures.
reproduction: Sign in as ana@example.test with a wrong password 5 times
Sign in with the right password
defects.impact: Passwords can be guessed without limit.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a bounded rate-limit check driven by the stated limit.

defects.expected: A note's title is shown as plain text on its page.
defects.actual: A note's title is put into its page unescaped, so markup in it becomes part of the page.
reproduction: Open its page: the heading contains a real <b> element
defects.impact: Stored markup injection; with a weaker page policy, script injection into anyone who reads the note.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: Needs a write with a marker payload and a reopen of the page that shows it.

defects.expected: Deleting a note also deletes its shares; no stored share is left for a note that no longer exists.
defects.actual: Deleting a note leaves its share rows in the stored data.
defects.preconditions: Signed in as ben@example.test, owner of n3 (shared with ana).
reproduction: The stored data has note_shares rows for n3
defects.impact: Stored data grows inconsistent; a reused note id would be shared by mistake.

detectableWithCurrentInfrastructure.why: The API never shows it; only a read of the stored data does.
